title: Define the business model and unit economics
summary: Before committing to a customer segment, product model or major operating change. An approved business-model brief with tested assumptions, contribution economics and the next validation decision.
outcomes: An approved business-model brief with tested assumptions, contribution economics and the next validation decision.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: Before committing to a customer segment, product model or major operating change.

parts.title: Describe the customer and value exchange
parts.guidance: Write down who uses the product, who pays, the problem addressed, the delivery model and alternatives. Separate observed customer evidence from founder assumptions and link the evidence to each assumption.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Model contribution economics
parts.guidance: Build scenarios for price, acquisition cost, delivery cost, support load and retention using explicit units and time periods. Label unknowns and reconcile revenue assumptions with how billing and collections will work.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Choose a testable business-model hypothesis
parts.guidance: Review the scenarios with the responsible founders. Select the smallest commercial test, the cash exposure allowed and the evidence that would cause a change of direction.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Connect the hypothesis to the operating plan
parts.guidance: Turn the selected model into named customer, product, financing and hiring milestones. Record dependencies rather than treating projected revenue as money already available.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Review evidence and approve the next commitment
parts.guidance: Compare actual customer behavior and delivery costs with the agreed test. Record whether to continue, revise or stop, with the owner and evidence for the next review.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Review evidence and approve the next commitment

verify.how: An approved business-model brief with tested assumptions, contribution economics and the next validation decision.
